evidence_basis: Published source theory. Source auditing and comparisons are not independent recalculation or experimental validation.

prior.summary: New to the reviewed candidate mechanism catalogue, source prediction already published; not first discovery.
prior.case_context: Exact Zr3Lu ordered search found no primary experimental exact SC phase. SG221 Zr3Lu differs from ordinary Zr-rich solid solution and from source ScZr3/Hf variants; known chemistry does not establish same-phase alias.

sources.title: Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds
Primary source study: conventional superconducting compounds

prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: Lu target improves source lambda and Tc against Sc and Hf frozen controls; TiZr3 has lower lambda but higher Tc. This demonstrates that omega_log and electronic/mass changes must accompany lambda, and avoids ranking raw lambda as universally superior. All target forces zero; order/disorder and low-energy competing alloy phase remain untested.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Source coarse force 0.0 eV/Å, pressure -0.0 GPa; fine force 0.0 eV/Å, pressure 0.001 GPa. Actual full stress, Γ interval, finite path and q observations are retained in the complete review; no whole-BZ/global-stability claim.

counterevidence.scope: Coupling and separate source-model Tc move in opposite directions against this alternative; a monotonic coupling-to-Tc explanation is insufficient.

unknowns: Experimental superconductivity in this exact state
Direct support for approximately 300 K at ambient pressure

proposed_contribution.intervention: Sc/Hf-to-Lu minority-role construction in Zr3X cubic order. coupled chemical/site-role/volume/mass construction, not isolated geometry or inferred W/n
proposed_contribution.next_action: Inspect existing Zr-network mode/active-state changes for Lu/Sc/Hf and retain Ti counterexample. Favorable: a matched paired benefit on ordered branch survives refinement; adverse: order or phonon scale benefit disappears; ambiguous: no phase-ordering distinction.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
